scope: Ibuprofen IR reference cross-check: SDBS / AIST

primary_source.title: SDBS Compound Landing — SDBS No. 41004
primary_source.publisher: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST), Japan
primary_source.rights_note: SDBS states that profit-making/commercial use requires prior permission; respect AIST terms and attribution.

findings.identity_caveat: The SDBS entry is explicitly (S)-(+)-ibuprofen, whereas the PharmaSpectra ibuprofen identity is the general/racemic API entry. Do not silently treat the enantiopure reference as a racemate measurement.
findings.integration_decision: Add as an external IR reference only. No numerical data file was retrieved and validated; do not draw a synthetic curve or claim local spectrum integration.

findings.status: raw experimental absorbance series not retrieved

additional_candidate_dataset.title: Raw and processed in vitro release (IVRT) data for an ibuprofen/poloxamer-407 gel study
additional_candidate_dataset.contains: Raw UV-Vis absorbance readings and calibration workbooks for formulation release experiments.
additional_candidate_dataset.limitation: These are formulation/IVRT release measurements, not an intrinsic reference absorption spectrum of pure ibuprofen. Do not mix them with the pure-API UV spectrum.

findings.integration_decision: Do not import the formulation release measurements into the pure ibuprofen UV spectrum slot. They may be used later in a separate formulation/analytical-method dataset.
